description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for managing Widget Types in the Thingsboard platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting widget types, as well as fetching widget type information and details, with support for filtering and resource inclusion.

classes.name: WidgetTypeController
classes.description: REST controller for managing widget types, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and retrieval with filtering options.

methods.name: getWidgetTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves widget type details by ID, optionally including resources.

methods.name: getWidgetTypeInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves lightweight widget type info by ID.

methods.name: saveWidgetType
methods.description: Creates or updates a widget type, with optional update by FQN.

methods.name: deleteWidgetType
methods.description: Deletes a widget type by ID.

methods.name: getWidgetTypes
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of widget types with filtering options.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypesByBundleAlias
methods.description: Deprecated method to get widget types by bundle alias.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypesV1
methods.description: Gets widget types by widget bundle ID.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypes
methods.description: Gets widget types for a specific bundle ID.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypesDetailsByBundleAlias
methods.description: Deprecated method to get widget type details by bundle alias.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypesDetails
methods.description: Gets widget type details for a specific bundle ID, with optional resource inclusion.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypeFqns
methods.description: Retrieves widget type FQNs for a bundle.

methods.name: getBundleWidgetTypesInfos
methods.description: Retrieves widget type info objects for a bundle with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getWidgetTypeByBundleAliasAndTypeAlias
methods.description: Deprecated method to get widget type by bundle and type alias.

methods.name: getWidgetType
methods.description: Retrieves widget type by FQN, with permission check.
